## Ctx.bottomKeyboard() method

Creates a bottom (reply) keyboard using a builder callback.

**Signature:**

```typescript
bottomKeyboard(callback: (k: ITBottomKb, l: string[]) => ITBottomKb, params?: ITBottomKbParams | null): ITBottomKb;
```

**Returns:**

[ITBottomKb](./gramstax.itbottomkb.md)

The bottom keyboard instance.

## Remarks

The callback receives the keyboard instance and an array of button labels from the template. Automatically applies `resized()` to the keyboard.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackQueryData() {
  const kb = this.bottomKeyboard((k, labels) => {
    labels.forEach(label => k.text(label))
    return k
  })
  await this.render(kb)
}
```
